title: Rudra: Finding Memory Safety Bugs in Rust at the Ecosystem Scale
source_finding: Unsafe dependencies can undermine guarantees of safe calling code.
limitation: Ecosystem bug-finding is not proof that this project has a memory defect.
project_action: Keep unsafe forbidden in first-party modules; review transitive crates and security advisories.

title: RULF: Rust Library Fuzzing via API Dependency Graph Traversal
source_finding: API sequence generation can increase Rust library fuzz coverage.
limitation: Published library workloads do not establish correctness of our CSV/JSON parser.
project_action: Add bounded fuzz targets for model-deserialization; adversarial specimen CSV; and CLI options.

title: Flux: Liquid Types for Rust
source_finding: Refinement types support stronger invariants in selected Rust programs.
limitation: Prototype formal technique not a default general-purpose production lint.
project_action: Use explicit finite-value and shape invariants first; study Flux for high-risk kernels only.

title: Verus: Verifying Rust Programs using Linear Ghost Types
source_finding: SMT-backed proof specifications can establish properties beyond borrowing checks.
limitation: Formal proof demonstrations do not verify Linfa optimization or current native training.
project_action: Consider proofs for small serialization and index invariants only after conventional tests.

title: RefinedRust: A Type System for High-Assurance Verification of Rust Programs
source_finding: Machine-checked refined ownership proofs can cover selected safe and unsafe Rust.
limitation: Prototype and Vec case study do not generalize to all numerical ML pipelines.
project_action: Avoid claiming verified numerical semantics merely from safe Rust compilation.

title: Beyond Memory Safety: an Empirical Study on Bugs and Fixes of Rust Programs
source_finding: Study characterizes non-memory defects and failures including panics in Rust projects.
limitation: Observational code sample is not a measured defect rate for this repository.
project_action: Add negative schema; panic; boundary; and computational regression checks.

title: Kani: A Model Checker for Rust
source_finding: Kani combines bounded checking and proof contracts for safety and correctness properties.
limitation: Preprint methods and case studies require review before adoption; not automatically peer reviewed.
project_action: Evaluate Kani for bounded parser and array-index properties after a prospective methods gate.

title: Targeted Fuzzing for Unsafe Rust Code: Leveraging Selective Instrumentation
source_finding: Selective instrumentation targets unsafe code in reported fuzzing research.
limitation: Preprint does not establish benefit for our safe first-party logistic pipeline.
project_action: Prioritize exposure surfaces and dependency review rather than fabricating performance gains.

title: The Rust Programming Language: error handling
source_finding: Recoverable errors are expressed with Result rather than hidden fallback paths.
limitation: Error handling constructs do not determine scientific failure policy.
project_action: Use Result at IO/schema/model boundaries; record failure and retain partial artifacts.

title: The Rust Programming Language: automated tests
source_finding: Unit and integration tests complement the type system.
limitation: Tests detect examples of defects but cannot prove total functional correctness.
project_action: Test missing columns; group leakage; class mapping; probability precision; and overwrite refusal.

title: Rust API Guidelines checklist
source_finding: Naming traits error types and API invariants should follow ecosystem conventions.
limitation: Recommendations are discretionary and not a formal standard or clinical validation.
project_action: Review public types and schema boundaries; avoid anonymous Boolean mode arguments.

title: rustdoc: How to write documentation
source_finding: Document public APIs with examples and failure behavior.
limitation: Documentation is not an executed correctness proof.
project_action: Document data units; class encoding; missingness; numerical errors; and examples.

title: Clippy: continuous integration
source_finding: Use matching toolchain Clippy and treat warnings as actionable CI evidence.
limitation: Static lints do not detect label leakage or invalid biological outcomes.
project_action: Keep pinned rustfmt and clippy strict alongside independent numerical tests.

title: Cargo.toml versus Cargo.lock
source_finding: Cargo.lock captures resolved dependency versions and supports repeatable builds.
limitation: Pinned dependencies do not guarantee bit-identical results on different machines.
project_action: Commit Cargo.lock; use --locked and save toolchain target profile and lock hash.

title: Cargo metadata command
source_finding: cargo metadata provides machine-readable workspace and dependency resolution.
limitation: Metadata output is sensitive to enabled features and target selection.
project_action: Record dependency graph and features for reproducible cross-runtime comparisons.

title: Cargo profiles
source_finding: Optimization debug assertions and overflow checks depend on build profile.
limitation: Release defaults differ from development checks; optimization may change numerical behavior.
project_action: Test debug and release fixtures; record flags and avoid undeclared fast math.

title: Rustonomicon: Working with unsafe
source_finding: Unsafe modules demand explicit invariants and encapsulation.
limitation: Unsafe documentation is background not authorization to add unsafe blocks.
project_action: Preserve forbid(unsafe_code); review all imported FFI and unsafe dependency surfaces.

title: Rust f64 primitive documentation
source_finding: f64 supports finite checks and explicit total ordering including NaNs.
limitation: IEEE representations alone cannot guarantee numerical reproducibility across optimizers.
project_action: Reject NaN/inf; use stable logit calculations; test extreme values and tolerances.

title: Serde container attributes
source_finding: deny_unknown_fields rejects unexpected keys in declared input structs.
limitation: A strict object schema can still contain unsafe or unauthorized field contents.
project_action: Validate provenance access classes identities and dimensions after deserialization.

title: OpenOptions create_new atomic creation
source_finding: create_new atomically rejects existing output files including symlinks.
limitation: Atomic single-file creation does not guarantee whole-directory archival integrity.
project_action: Use new outside-repo output directories and per-file exclusive writes.

title: Cargo test command
source_finding: Cargo executes unit integration and documentation tests.
limitation: Passing cargo test is not independent biomedical model validation.
project_action: Run --locked and all relevant features and targets in CI.

title: Rust 2024 edition migration guide
source_finding: Edition migrations require explicit compatibility review.
limitation: Current assay crate intentionally targets edition 2021 and Rust 1.90.
project_action: Do not silently change edition or MSRV within the frozen G3 protocol.

title: Rust Performance Book: Benchmarking
source_finding: Representative workloads and repeated measurements support responsible optimization.
limitation: Microbenchmarks cannot demonstrate clinical utility or cross-language superiority.
project_action: Only measure Rust/Python time after matched objectives and prediction parity.

title: Rust Performance Book: Profiling
source_finding: Profile CPU hot spots and memory before optimization.
limitation: Profiling by itself does not prove a model algorithm was correctly ported.
project_action: Separate IO preparation training inference and RSS measurements.

title: Unsafe Code Guidelines reference status
source_finding: The document identifies much of the unsafe guidance as abandoned/incomplete.
limitation: Do not treat incomplete historical recommendations as normative guarantees.
project_action: Prefer stable Rust docs; avoid new unsafe code in the research core.

title: RustSec Advisory Database
source_finding: Security advisories can be checked against dependencies in Cargo.lock.
limitation: No advisory match does not establish dependency absence of vulnerabilities.
project_action: Use scheduled advisory review and record exact dependency revisions.

title: cargo-deny dependency linting
source_finding: Check advisories licenses sources and duplicate/banned dependencies.
limitation: License allowlist needs legal/policy approval; no tool alone establishes compliance.
project_action: Pilot advisory and source checks on the Rust crate before requiring merges.

title: cargo-vet supply-chain audits
source_finding: Document independent audit coverage for third-party crates.
limitation: Audit provenance depends on trust in imported reviews and scope.
project_action: Use an approved audit policy for FFI and security-critical dependencies.

title: Rust Fuzz Book cargo-fuzz
source_finding: libFuzzer can exercise adversarial byte sequences at parser boundaries.
limitation: Fuzzing is probabilistic; zero crashes is not total correctness proof.
project_action: Fuzz CSV headers malformed UTF-8 JSON shape and oversized allocations offline.

title: Miri Rust MIR interpreter
source_finding: Miri can help detect undefined behavior in supported executions.
limitation: Miri does not explore every program path and needs a compatible toolchain.
project_action: Reserve as optional verification for low-level dependency/FFI wrappers.

title: ndarray 0.16.1 crate documentation
source_finding: ndarray encodes shapes dimensions and views for numerical matrices.
limitation: Shape-valid arrays can still contain scientifically wrong labels or units.
project_action: Validate nrows ncols row order missingness and finiteness before fitting.

title: linfa-logistic 0.8.1 crate documentation
source_finding: Pinned logistic API offers binary fitting and probability prediction.
limitation: An optimizer return is not evidence of convergence or sklearn objective equivalence.
project_action: Recompute objective and gradient independently and canonicalize class identity.

title: Criterion benchmarking library
source_finding: Statistical repeated benchmarks help quantify performance variation.
limitation: Microbenchmark confidence is not uncertainty about breast cancer model performance.
project_action: Use separate controlled performance study if numerical agreement succeeds.

title: Pragmatic Rust Guidelines checklist
source_finding: Additional engineering recommendations cover linting and API maintainability.
limitation: Organization-specific guidance is supplementary to upstream Rust documentation.
project_action: Use as optional code-review checklist; do not auto-enforce conflicting preferences.
